run_translation_pipeline: run the translation pipeline with a hydra config to translate files using fairseq
extract_tsv_column: extract a specific column from a TSV file and write it to a temporary text file
parse_tsv_column_path: parse a TSV column path in the format file_path:column_name into its components
check_tsv_column_path: check if a given path string is a valid TSV column reference format
shard_and_translate: shard large input files and run parallel translation jobs then merge outputs
